class.name: SteamRemotePlaySession
class.brief_description: A snapshot of a connected Steam Remote Play stream.
class.description: Use the session ID to associate a stream with a game-owned local player seat. Take a fresh snapshot when current device information is needed.

members.member: Reported streaming client's display resolution in pixels, or zero in both dimensions when Steam has no resolution.
Steam's transient stream ID. Use it to match input and disconnect signals to the active seat.
Decimal SteamID64, or an empty string when Steam has no individual account ID for the guest.
Whether the stream was created using a Remote Play Together invitation.
